name: Attribute Quantization
definition: A lossy compression technique that reduces attribute precision (colors and normals) to lower memory footprint while maintaining perceptual quality, assessed using CIE94 delta-E and SSIM metrics.
summary: Attribute Quantization reduces voxel attribute memory by mapping colors to CIELAB codebooks and normals to octahedron coordinates, outperforming generic uniform methods through perceptual specialization.
